programme.title: Nelson's Caribbean Hell-Hole: An Eighteenth Century Navy Graveyard Uncovered
programme.desc: Human bones found on an idyllic beach in Antigua trigger an investigation by naval historian Sam Willis into one of the darkest chapters of Britain's imperial past. As archaeologists excavate a mass grave of British sailors, Willis explores Antigua's ruins and discovers how the sugar islands of the Caribbean were a kind of hell in the age of Nelson.

programme.title: DeLorean: Back from the Future
programme.desc: John Z DeLorean's extraordinary and doomed attempt to build the sports car of the future in 1980s Northern Ireland is the stuff of legend. DeLorean had film star looks, a famous fashion model as a wife and an enormous ego.

programme.title: Tuesday Documentary
programme.desc: Motor race, fun-fair, sponsors' bonanza, death trap. Whatever it is, the 24-hour race at Le Mans has become a legend; for the driver, just to finish is an achievement; for the fans, to be there is a unique experience. For the race marshals and police there is little chance to relax, for when tragedy strikes it can be swift and terrible. First aired in 1982.

programme.sub-title: The Luck of the Irish Sea
programme.desc: Untrained mariner Timothy Spall has spent a fortune on technology for his new challenge - the unpredictable Irish Sea - as he and his wife continue their mini-odyssey around Britain. However, Captain Spall bungles his departure to Fishguard and ends up going nowhere at full speed due to the turning tides.

programme.title: Japan's Master of Restoration
programme.desc: A museum in Osaka asks the Mayuyamas for help with artefacts currently hidden away in their archive. An exquisite 800-year-old celadon vase from China and a 16th-century Totoya Chawan tea bowl both require their expert attention to be brought back to life.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Treasures
programme.desc: Dan is captivated by the sword of a Samurai warrior and the artistry employed to make this beautiful instrument of death. By contrast, he finds solace and tranquillity in a Japanese temple and meditation garden.
